intent: Define the governed Zenodo publication template, requiring formal stack declaration, charter compliance, data availability, and citation provenance.

template.data_availability_statement: All simulation data and configuration files required to reproduce the results are included in this bundle.
template.citation_provenance_rule: Every claim must cite its evidence_id and recovery_path within the bundle.

rules.name: no_zenodo_publication_without_complete_bundle_v1
rules.statement: Zenodo-targeted publications must include paper, metadata, provenance, falsification, and config subdirectories.

rules.name: no_citation_without_evidence_id_v1
rules.statement: Claims in Zenodo bundles must cite evidence_id and auditable recovery paths.
